changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code IN ('ADMIN', 'MANAGER', 'CLIENT', 'FOREMAN', 'FINANCIER', 'ESTIMATOR') AND res.code = 'CLIENT_MESSAGES' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources rr WHERE rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.resource_id = res.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('CREATE', 'READ', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'CLIENT_MESSAGES' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations rro WHERE rro.role_resource_id = rr.id AND rro.operation_id = o.id );
